items.title: The kernel and the cokernel of an idempotent endomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the kernel and the cokernel of an idempotent endomorphism of an object of a preadditive category: each of the two, when it exists, is split by a morphism built from the complementary idempotent and serves as the other (statement lines 583-609). The proof is a complete argument for the first assertion, giving both the splitting of the kernel map and the universal property of the cokernel by explicit computations with the complementary idempotent (proof lines 612-628), after which the remaining assertions follow by duality and by exchanging the roles of the two idempotents (proof lines 630-635). The non-formal content is the construction of the splitting and of the map witnessing the universal property. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
